review_candidates.title: Senior Cloud Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Senior Cloud Engineer Accountability Statement The Senior Cloud Engineer will plan, design, configure and maintain VyStar’s enterprise Azure cloud server and storage environments and will lead the management and further development of VyStar’s private and public cloud infrastructure. The candidate should have a clear understanding of how to research, design, implement and troubleshoot information systems, cloud technologies and technology solutions in support of business needs. Essential Job Fun
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Job Qualifications Education This position requires a 4-year degree in Information Systems, Computer Engineering or a related academic area and a minimum of 5 years’ experience as a systems engineer or in a related position. Additional years of related experience in the field may be substituted for the formal education. Experience 5 - 7 years of Enterprise level work experience in Systems Engineering or in a related position with physical and virtual Microsoft-based systems; ideally in a financial services organization (or related industry). 3+ years of experience managing a production Azure cloud environment Experience with establishing technology guidelines based on best practices in enterprise level systems engineering. Your resume will be carefully reviewed against the position requirements.

review_candidates.title: System Engineer (gn) Windows Server Administration
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Mit Fokus auf Windows Server Infrastructure Managed Services übernimmst du: Architektur, Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung komplexer Enterprise-Windows-Server-Umgebungen sowie Fehleranalyse, Troubleshooting und die kontinuierliche Optimierung von Services und Prozessen. Kenntnisse und Fähigkeiten Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Enterprise-Windows-Server-Umgebungen sowie in den Bereichen Betrieb, Troubleshooting, Weiterentwicklung und Serviceoptimierung von geschäftskritischen Infrastrukturen. Weitere wicht
eligibility_evidence: Praktische Informationen Standort: Deutschlandweit | Beschäftigungsart: Unbefristet | Arbeitszeit: Vollzeit | Arbeitsmodell: Hybrid/Remote | Sprachen: Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift | Bereitschaft zur Rufbereitschaft Unser Hybrid Managed Service stellt die Leistungsfäh
